Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“Something is about to happen. Move.”

Echo-Diver (Empyrean). You tune to the upper airs — storm-forecast, lightning-warning, the lean of a thing before it falls.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Stormread (precognition). Add your Tier to all Initiative rolls.
  • Lightning-Ally. 1/Soma Break, when you roll initiative, one willing ally within 30 ft may use their reaction immediately to move up to half their movement without provoking opportunity strikes.
  • Weathered. Reroll the lowest die on Perception checks that rely on hearing or air currents.
  • Signature. You gain Stormread at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Echo-Diver (Empyrean) signature feat: Stormread.
